### DJ Spuggy & DJ PC — back-to-back all night @ NCF Cultural Co-op, Ballina

![DJ Spuggy & DJ PC](news/dj-spuggy-pc.jpg)

From 9:30pm upstairs in the NCF, two selectors go track-for-track, blending distinct sounds into one dancefloor narrative.

DJ PC brings his Hybrid Digital/Vinyl set of driving house, pulsing techno, and cuts across dub, disco, soul, funk, and breakbeat, always rooted in groove.

DJ Spuggy delivers house, techno, off-kilter Italo, and raw EBM with a leftfield twist.

Expect left turns, locked grooves, and deep cuts that keep you guessing. No egos. No fillers. Just proper tunes for open minds and moving feet.
